series_label: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider (Nigeria; Sex Total, Age 15-49, Wealth Total, Residence Total)
source_or_custodian: UNICEF, MNCH dataflow (Maternal, child and newborn health), UNICEF/MNCH/1.0. Survey source by year: 2003 DHS 2003; 2008 DHS 2008; 2011 MICS 2011; 2013 DHS 2013; 2017 MICS 2016-2017; 2018 DHS 2018; 2021 MICS 2021; 2024 DHS 2023-2024 (source link 'CRAVE 2024')
status_or_notes: Data exist only for survey years. No observations for 2000-2002, 2004-2007, 2009-2010, 2012, 2014-2016, 2019-2020, 2022-2023 or 2025. All observations: OBS_STATUS=RP (Reported), OBS_CONF=F (Free), DATA_SOURCE_PRIORITY=1, TIME_PERIOD_METHOD=EOF (end of fieldwork). Lower and upper bounds are empty. The values mix DHS and MICS sources, so the change from one year to the next is not strictly comparable.
definition: Antenatal care 4+ visits - percentage of women (aged 15-49 years) attended at least four times during pregnancy by any provider
